Delhi Government Streamlines Cinema Hall Licensing Process

The Delhi government has notified Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) to establish an integrated single-window system for cinema hall licensing. This initiative aims to simplify and expedite the process of obtaining licenses for these establishments. The new system is designed to reduce bureaucratic hurdles and improve the ease of doing business for cinema hall operators in the capital.
